# vcp_project_consumption_daily (Data Source)

Reads what the project was charged on each day of a period.

The period is counted in the partner's time zone (`time_zone`) and both ends are inclusive. It may be at most 366 days long.

~> While `is_final` is `false` the period reaches today and its amounts still grow as the day is billed: a plan run later can read a different `total`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What the project was charged on each day of October.
data "vcp_project_consumption_daily" "october" {
  from = "2026-10-01"
  to   = "2026-10-31"
}

output "daily" {
  value = { for d in data.vcp_project_consumption_daily.october.days : d.date => d.total }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) First day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to the first day of the current month.
- `to` (String) Last day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to today. Must not be earlier than `from`.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency of the amounts — the project currency, as in `vcp_project`.
- `days` (Attributes List) Amount per day, in date order. Every day of the period is listed; a day without charges has a `total` of `0`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--days))
- `is_final` (Boolean) `false` while `to` is not earlier than today: the last day is still being billed.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of the partner, in which the period dates are counted.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged to the project over the period; the sum of `days`.

<a id="nestedatt--days"></a>
### Nested Schema for `days`

Read-Only:

- `date` (String) Day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in the partner's time zone.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged on the day.
